description: This source file defines the Marketplace class within the Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension namespace. It manages operations for the marketplace extension, including listing available extensions, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions. The class interacts with models, controllers, language files, and system configurations to facilitate extension management in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions, including listing, installing, and uninstalling extensions within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of available marketplace extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available extensions, both installed and available in the system, with their statuses and control URLs.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installing a marketplace extension, including permission checks, file validation, and updating extension registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstalling a marketplace extension, including permission checks, removing extension data, and cleanup.
